stats.DAMAGE FALLOFF: Falloff begins at 20m, decreasing to 80% at 40m
stats.FIRE RATE: The firing interval between shots is 0.12s, with an interval of 0.8s between each round of shooting

name: Monster-Piercer
description: Unleash your elephant gun forward. Bullets pierce enemies and deal high damage.

name: Apex Predator
description: Summon the Glartrox to charge forward. The Glartrox can be recalled to charge back along the same path. When colliding with terrain or upon return, it bites fiercely, dealing heavy damage.

stats.GLARTROX MAXIMUM DASH DURATION: Maximum durations for dashing and returning are 3.5s each

name: Helix Advance
description: Dash forward. Your next Double-Barrel Blaster becomes Monster-Piercer.

name: Ruthless Pursuit
description: Dash forward, gaining Bonus Health and launching enemies hit. Follow up with a Double-Barrel Blaster shot that propels you backward and Slows enemies. Using either stage empowers your next Double-Barrel Blaster, transforming it into Monster-Piercer.

stats.BONUS HEALTH: Every unleash of Ruthless Pursuit and Helix Advance grants 30 bonus health. Max bonus health is 75

name: Smoky Snare
description: Launch a trap containing the monster Diablo. Once deployed, it becomes Invisible and Invulnerable. When an enemy triggers it, Diablo Immobilizes and damages them. Use {{#switch: {{{p|}}} | PC = F | PS5 =  | Xbox = }} to dash to the trapped enemy. Enemies can destroy Diablo to break free.

name: Living Bullet
description: Fire a Living Bullet round that splits upon impact, seeking nearby enemies and marking each with a Spectral Sigil. Hitting marked targets with Double-Barrel Blaster or Monster-Piercer grants Elsa a brief Speed boost. Living Bullets deal extra damage to shields and enemies with Bonus Health.

name: Inherited Instinct
description: Dealing damage increases hunting Instinct. Defeating enemies caught by Smoky Snare grants additional Instinct. Higher Instinct reduces the cooldown of Helix Advance.

name: Bloodstone's Boombox Bullets
description: Deadpool hands Jeff the Land Shark a plushie. Jeff can spit it ahead where it'll continuously Taunt nearby enemies and Block Vision, while allies in range are healed! Elsa's Bloodstone Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. Elsa can recall the rounds to heal based on damage dealt.
